description: Putting the P in perfectly portable, the lightweight Brompton P Line is an expertly engineered folding bike for moving in the city and beyond. Built to last from tig-welded titanium and hand-brazed steel. The main frame is finished in a special edition shade of Brunswick Green, complemented by beautiful brass and rose gold accents, highlighting the finer points of the bike and a subtle nod to the inner workings and hand-finished elements of the accompanying makers series items.This limited-edition Brompton features a special saddle roll, inspired by the watch rolls of our collaborator Bremont, in brown Italian leather that matches the Cheaney and Sons Chelsea boots. Designed to pair with the Brooks saddle like a traditional saddle roll, echoing the intention of the overall collection as an exercise in both form and function.

Superlight lock-on grips with precision ground foam adhered to ultra thin engineered core

Brooks B17 Special saddle with handhammered copper rivets for long life
Brompton 4 speed derailleur shifter & 3 speed hub gear shifter

Double wall rim, double-butted spokes and aluminum hub body
Superlight front wheel - Lightweight, double wall rim, double-butted spokes and aluminum hub body
